# @stackline/proxyquire

Install: `npm install --save-dev @stackline/proxyquire`
Drop-in alias: `npm install --save-dev proxyquire@npm:@stackline/proxyquire`
Current release: `{{PACKAGE_VERSION}}`
Repository: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-proxyquire
Documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/proxyquire/

Compatibility-first continuation of `proxyquire@2.1.3` for CommonJS dependency
stubbing. The callable API, `.load`, call-through, cache, global, missing-module,
and non-object-stub behavior are preserved. The exact-pinned
An internal lexical CommonJS resolver preserves request identity with zero
runtime, optional, or peer dependencies. Node 12-24.
TypeScript 3.9 and current.

ESM and native-TypeScript tests use `createProxyquire(import.meta.url)` to load
CommonJS subjects. Native ESM import bindings are not intercepted.
